name: Diploma Business Management
title: Diploma in Business Management
intro: The business management diploma roadmap: eligibility, admission, core subjects, internships and career steps.

phases.title: Eligibility
phases.summary: Class 12 for a diploma; graduation for PG diplomas.
points: Diploma programmes after Class 12 prepare you for entry-level business roles.
PG Diploma in Management (PGDM) after graduation is also offered by many institutes.
Choose institutes approved by AICTE for PGDM/PGDBM.
Check the placement and industry tie-ups.

phases.title: Admission process
points: Apply to institutes and universities offering diplomas.
PG diplomas often use CAT, XAT, CMAT, MAT or institute tests.
Selection may include group discussion and interview.
Pay fees to confirm admission.

phases.title: Core subjects
points: Study Principles of Management, Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations and Business Communication.
Learn accounting basics and business law.
Practise through case studies and presentations.
Learn tools such as Excel and PowerPoint.

phases.title: Internships and projects
points: Do summer internships and live projects with local businesses.
Write a project report and present it.
Join business clubs and competitions.
Build a network of mentors.

phases.title: Careers and next steps
points: Roles: sales executive, business development associate, HR assistant, operations coordinator.
Further study: BBA, MBA or professional courses.
Entrepreneurship: small business management.
Government and bank exams are open to graduates.
